column4: Record number assigned by the VizieR team. Should Not be used for identification.
Gaia DR2 barycentric right ascension (ICRS) at epoch J2015.5 (ra)
Gaia DR2 barycentric declination (ICRS) at epoch J2015.5 (dec)
Absolute stellar parallax of the source at J2015.5 (parallax)
Standard error of proper motion in right ascension (pmra_error)
Standard error of proper motion in declination (pmdec_error)
Measure of the residuals in the astrometric solution for the source (astrometric_excess_noise)
Five-dimensional equivalent to the semi-major axis of the Gaia position error ellipse (astrometric_sigma5d_max)
GBP/GRP excess factor estimated from the comparison of the sum of integrated GBP and GRP fluxes with respect to the flux in the G-band (phot_bp_rp_excess_factor)
The number of Gaia sources per square degree around this object (density)
Extinction in the Gaia G-band band derived from E(B-V) values from Schlafly and Finkbeiner (2011ApJ...737..103S) (AG)
SDSS object name if available (JHHMMSS,.ss+DDMMSS.s, J2000) (SDSS_name)
[0/1]? The probability of being a white dwarf (Pwd)
[0/1] If 1 it indicates the PWD value could be unreliable (Pwd_flag)
? Effective temperature from fitting the dereddened G,GBP, and GRP absolute fluxes with pure-H model atmospheres (Teff_H)
? Surface gravity from fitting the dereddened G,GBP,and GRP absolute fluxes with pure-H model atmospheres (log_g_H)
? Stellar mass resulting from the adopted mass-radius relation (mass_H)
? Effective temperature from fitting the dereddened G,GBP, and GRP absolute fluxes with pure-He model atmospheres (Teff_He)
